description:
The Urban Arrow FamilyNext comes with everything you’ve come to love and expect from us. Built to the highest standards, this electric cargo bike offers our most spacious design yet, ensuring ultimate child safety for your most precious cargo. By equipping the bike with premium components from our trusted partners (hello, Bosch drive unit and Schwalbe tyres!), we ensure a ride of unrivaled quality. With its lowered centre of gravity, you’ll feel stable, comfortable, and always in control. This is the smart, proven choice and simply the best cargo bike for your family. This is family transport redefined. Sleek, spacious and incredibly smooth. Discover why it’s the ultimate cargo bike for family life.

Taking care of safety features is self-evident to us. That is why we aim to always take it to the next level, because your family’s safety can never be safe enough. Let’s glow up! For early bird rides and evening commutes, the integrated reflection elements ensure you’re always seen, no matter the time nor the weather. For even more visibility and style, our design LED lights are a total game-changer, lighting your way and alerting other road users instantly.

It's the iconic smooth ride of our classic Family model but elevated with a premium integrated suspension front fork. This means ultimate comfort for you and a buttery-smooth, bump-free ride for the kids. Effortlessly loading up is easy, due to its even more spacious box and a redesigned entry step that simplifies stepping in and out for small children. Total hassle-free security of your cargo is guaranteed with our upgraded seatbelt closing system. It’s peace of mind, more than ever before.

Bring on the unpredictable weather days. With the purchase of an Urban Arrow Family or FamilyNext, you'll receive a Raincover Plus worth €379 as a gift. So your kids will always step in dry and comfortable.

We already knew the Urban Arrow FamilyNext was a next-level champion. Now independent experts have just confirmed it. Our newest family member has already won several remarkable awards! We’re seriously proud of this recognition. Ready to explore what makes it the best electric cargo bike on the market? Discover all the award-winning features today.

Tailor your ride to your specific needs. Protect your cargo with our durable raincover, or add an extra bench or rear carrier to fit the whole crew. Want extra security? We’ve got you covered with Urban Arrow Connected, keeping you linked to your bike at all times. From increased functionality to everyday comfort, our accessories make every ride a pleasant, worry-free experience.

The FamilyNext introduces an integrated suspension front fork, a redesigned and more spacious box, a higher backrest, improved seating, a new seatbelt closing system, and integrated reflection elements for better visibility. The redesigned box and protection tube also enhance both durability and the bike's streamlined look.

The FamilyNext is Urban Arrow's newest model, featuring front fork suspension, a new design, and functional improvements, while the original Family bike has a proven track record of over a decade serving families worldwide. Both are exceptional cargo bikes, each suited to different preferences.

The design LED lights are an optional accessory available for installation at your local Urban Arrow dealer. They are included as standard only on the FamilyNext Pro 100Nm model.

General and rear accessories such as the floormat, rear carriers, ponchos, and Urban Arrow Connected are fully compatible with the FamilyNext. Box-specific accessories like the rain cover, extra bench, baby seat adapter, and box cover have been redesigned to fit the FamilyNext's updated front frame.

Yes, Urban Arrow Connected is available as an aftermarket accessory for the FamilyNext, priced at €399 including four years of data connectivity.

The FamilyNext comes with everything you’ve come to love and expect from us, and even more! It offers the most spacious and sleek design, innovative safety features and the best equipment for ultimate comfort. To guarantee this ultimate comfort the Urban Arrow FamilyNext is equipped with an integrated suspension fork, a redesigned box that simplifies stepping in and out. A new comfortable saddle offering comfort during your ride. Both the box and the protection tube have been redesigned which not only adds to the cargo bikes streamlined look but also enhance durability and safety. The black spokes and new harness fabrics are those details that make the FamilyNext stand-out. Visibility in traffic is of course key. The newly integrated reflection elements in the box ensure you’re seen. For even more visibility, the LED lights are a game-changer by lighting your way and alerting others. Plus, the higher backrest, better seating and new seatbelt closing system offer safety and stability for your precious cargo.

The Urban Arrow FamilyNext Pro is designed with a one-size-fits-most frame that accommodates riders approximately 5'1" to 6'6".

The Urban Arrow FamilyNext is our newest addition to the Family. For the very first time in Urban Arrow history we gave our iconic Urban Arrow Family a new look. While the FamilyNext consists of new features such as its front fork suspension, new design and functional improvements, our original Family bike still has a famous trackrecord for more than a decade of serving the mobility needs of thousands of families around the world. An exceptional cargo bike that gets the job done and will bring you lots of pleasure, comfort and happiness for years to come.

All general and rear accessories, floormat, rear carriers, parka en ponchos, are fully compatible with the FamilyNext, ensuring carefree rides and continued convenience for your riding experience. Due to the Urban Arrow FamilyNext updated frontframe design we had to make slight changes in the accessories that are used on the box. We have carefully selected the most used accessories and adapted them to fit the new design of the Urban Arrow FamilyNext. These updated accessories include the Urban Arrow FamilyNext Raincover Plus, extra bench, baby-seat adapter and box cover.

We have carefully selected the most used Family accessories and adapted them to fit the new design of the Urban Arrow FamilyNext. These updated accessories include the Urban Arrow FamilyNext Raincover Plus, extra bench, baby-seat adapter and box cover.

Please get in touch with your local dealer for the latest availability of the Urban Arrow FamilyNext. Delivery times may be longer than usual, so be sure to check with your dealer for the most current updates.

Please use our dealer locator here to find your nearest Urban Arrow dealer and ask them about the availability of the Urban Arrow FamilyNext. It’s best to visit or call your local Urban Arrow dealer and inquire directly, as we unfortunately don’t have insight in their current stock.

The standard bench on the Urban Arrow FamilyNext can carry a maximum weight of 220 lbs (100 kg). However, there is a sticker on this bench indicating that the maximum weight is 36 kg (80lbs). This limit refers to the maximum weight to which the seatbelt is tested and therefore does not apply to the bench’s carrying capacity. We would like to stress that, as with previous Family models, the maximum load capacity of the bench is tested to 100 kg. If you have any questions about this, please contact our service centre at service@urbanarrow.com.

A cargo bike with a spacious cargo box and sufficient seats is ideal for large families. Models such as the Urban Arrow FamilyNext are specially designed for transporting several children and offer a lot of comfort and safety.

The Urban Arrow FamilyNext cargo bike is specially designed for transporting your most precious cargo—your children. The age at which you can ride with your children in an Urban Arrow FamilyNext depends on several factors, including their weight and size, as well as the specific configuration of the bike.
